<timestamp>Monday, Sep 21, 2026, 9:49 PM (UTC+8)</timestamp>
<user_query>
整理今天的日报
</user_query>
先按日报规范对齐口径，再汇总今天实际做过的活。
继续汇总今日 work-log、派单与对话流水。

input.command: bash ~/.dc-platform/memory/scripts/prepare_daily_report_sync.sh 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "---HOST---"; echo "WORKLOG_HOST_ID=${WORKLOG_HOST_ID:-unset}"; hostname; cat ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/.host_id 2>/dev/null; ls -la ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/reports/ 2>/dev/null | tail -5; ls -la ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/2026-09-21* 2>/dev/null; ls -la /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/work-log/2026-09-21* 2>/dev/null
input.description: Sync dual-mac worklog and find today files

input.command: DATE=2026-09-21; echo "=== provenance ==="; rg -n "$DATE|2026-09-21" "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | tail -80; echo "=== inbox (today-ish) ==="; rg -n "2026-09-21|\"ts\".*21" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | tail -60; echo "=== sent today ==="; rg -n "2026-09-21" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.json" 2>/dev/null | tail -40; ls "$HOME/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/" 2>/dev/null | head -30

# host id + today's inbox by date fields
python3 <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
CST = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-09-21"
paths = [
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
  print("====", p, "exists", os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0; hits=[]
  with open(p, "r", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      n+=1
      if day not in line:
        continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        hits.append(("raw", line[:200])); continue
      # summarize
      bus=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to")
      kind=o.get("kind") or o.get("source") or o.get("type")
      text=(o.get("text") or o.get("body") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("content") or "")[:120]
      ts=o.get("ts") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("time") or ""
      hits.append((bus, kind, ts, text.replace("\n"," ")))
  print("lines", n, "hits", len(hits))
  for h in hits[-40:]:
    print(h)
PY
ls ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/new-mac/2026-09-21.md 2>/dev/null && wc -l ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/new-mac/2026-09-21.md
# check host identity
cat ~/.dc-platform/memory/WORKLOG_HOST_ID 2>/dev/null; cat ~/.dc-platform/.host_id 2>/dev/null; env | rg -i 'WORKLOG|HOST_ID|AUTHORITY' || true
# recent lesson about attribution today
ls -lt ~/.dc-platform/memory/lessons/2026-09-21* 2>/dev/null | head
